# Mr Sander

> > Professional wood floor sanding, restoration, and installation services across London, specializing in parquet, engineered floors, and commercial projects with BS EN 14904 compliance.

Mr Sander® is a London-based flooring specialist serving areas including Hackney, Canary Wharf, Greenwich, and North London. The company is affiliated with the Wood Flooring Association and provides expert floor sanding, gap filling, staining, parquet installation, and commercial flooring solutions for sports arenas, salons, and businesses throughout the UK.
